quarterly_data.quarter: Astera Labs Citi’s Global TMT Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: WHY MI450 RUNS UALINK OVER ETHERNET, AND WHAT IT MEANS FOR ASTERA CONTENT: asked about the first Helios server, CEO Jitendra Mohan declined to speak for AMD but reiterated AMD's public position - 'for the MI450 series, they are going to go with UALink running over Ethernet. That has really got everything to do with the fact that UALink switches are not yet available', so MI450 must tunnel UALink over Ethernet - while AMD has said it will keep offering both UALink over Ethernet and native UALink in future generations, which Mohan expects to coexist. The content consequence he spelled out generically: where Astera does not supply the scale-up switching, its content is limited to scale-out retimers, Scorpio P, Taurus Ethernet retimers and active electrical cables; where the scale-up protocol is one Astera supports (PCI Express, UALink or something in between) and a Scorpio X solution can be used, 'then our content really does explode a lot, because scale up is a very rich area for connectivity solutions'. He added that the in-network compute, Hypercast, diagnostics and telemetry built into today's Scorpio X, exposed through COSMOS software, carry forward to a UALink-based Scorpio X, making the migration easy for existing Scorpio X users.

quarterly_data.signal: UALINK ADOPTION SIGNALS FOR 2027: Mohan said UALink traction is building (product announcements, broad IP availability, compliance methodologies being finalized) and cited two public roadmaps - AWS said at re:Invent that the part printed 'Phranyon four' in the transcript, slated to ramp in 2027, will support UALink as well as NVLink Fusion, and AMD said its MI 500 series will support UALink in 2027. Astera will be 'ready to intercept the initial customer platform ramp in 2027'. Asked whether MI 500 is native UALink rather than UALink over Ethernet, he declined to speak for AMD but said AMD's public materials say 'they will continue to support both' and that 'they believe UA Link native is the highest performance scale-up protocol'. On Ethernet scale-up (printed 'ESON'), he expects protocols to coexist ('these solutions will coexist'); Astera could build an Ethernet scale-up part, but 'so far, everybody is telling us to focus on UA Link'. Current development already stretches to 'UV link 200 gig' (as printed).
